hero.title: Give leftover construction material a second life.
hero.subtitle: Have leftover building materials? Sell them here. Need materials? Find them here, often for less than new.

whatItDoes.heading: What the system does
whatItDoes.description: Construction projects often buy more material than they use. After the work is done, extra tiles, bricks, cement, steel, pipes, paint, doors, electrical and sanitary items are left behind. Our system connects the project that has them with the project that needs them.

cards.recoverDesc: Sellers turn unused material back into money instead of letting it sit on site.
cards.reduceDesc: Material that is still good gets used again by another project.
cards.buyDesc: Buyers find the exact material and quantity they need, often without buying new.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Five simple steps from leftover to sold.

steps.registerDesc: Sign up as a Company with a trade license no., or as an Individual with an NID no. An admin approves your account.
steps.listDesc: Upload a photo. AI suggests the material type, color, pattern and surface. You confirm and publish.
steps.findDesc: Search the listings, or post what you need and see the best matches ranked by Match Score.
steps.orderDesc: Pay an advance online. Your order is confirmed when the advance payment succeeds.
steps.receiptDesc: Both sides receive a receipt with each other company details to arrange the material.

smartTools.heading: Smart tools built in
smartTools.subtitle: AI helps listing, matching and keeping the marketplace trustworthy.
smartTools.matchingDesc: Your requirement is compared with available listings on type, quantity, brand, quality, condition, price, location and date.
smartTools.checksDesc: Reused photos, unusually low prices and other warning signs are flagged for an admin to review.
